description: This header file declares a function related to checking the MLO (Mesh Local Optimization) readiness of an endpoint in a wireless LAN context. It includes licensing information, an include for 'wld.h', and a single function prototype 'wld_epMld_isMloReady'.

methods.name: wld_epMld_isMloReady
methods.description: Checks if a given endpoint is ready for MLO operation by verifying the presence of a valid MLO profile or shared connection configuration.
